IMPORTANT INFORMATION to Our Passengers
You are flying aboard a Boeing 727-200. It is unlikely we will encounter
a situation requiring emergency preparations, but it is good practice
to be acquainted with the safety features we have provided for you on
this aircraft.

AUTOMATIC
OXYGEN
SYSTEM
The higher altitudes at which this aircraft operates require prompt
use of the automatic oxygen system in case of any sudden change
in cabin pressure. Should a decompression occur, oxygen masks
will drop down automatically. Take nearest mask and promptly place
over nose and mouth and lean back in your seat.

INSTRUCTIONS FOR USE OF SEAT BELTS
LIFT TO UNFASTEN
Hold buckle and pull top strap for a tight fit. Please keep your seat
belt fastened at all times while in your seat.
FLOTATION
CUSHIONS

of cushion

for holding
The cushion you are seated on will float. In water landing remove
your cushion
as shown in diagram and take it with you in leaving
the aircraft.
PORTABLE ELECTRONIC DEVICES
Federal Aviation Agency (FAA) regulation prohibits the operation in-
flight of certain portable electronic devices since they can interfere
with the aircraft's navigation system. Please check with the Flight
Attendant before operating your radio, dictating machine or recorder.
